name: ModelRelationships
description: This collection contains all relationships between data tables in the data model of Excel 2013.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ModelRelationships object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of ModelRelationship objects in a ModelRelationships object. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from the ModelRelationships object.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number for the object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(ForeignKeyColumn As ModelTableColumn, PrimaryKeyColumn As ModelTableColumn) As ModelRelationship
methods.description: Adds a new relationship to the model.

parameters.name: ForeignKeyColumn
parameters.description: A ModelTableColumn object representing the foreign key column in the table on the many side of the one-to-many relationship.

parameters.name: PrimaryKeyColumn
parameters.description: A ModelTableColumn object representing the primary key column in the table on the one side of the one-to-many relationship.

methods.name: DetectRelationships
methods.description: Detects model relationships in the specified PivotTable object.

parameters.name: PivotTable
parameters.description: The PivotTable in which to detect model relationships.
